result.reason: The redline implements the preferred mutual cap of the greater of 12 months’ fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, while expressly leaving all defined Excluded Claims uncapped. It preserves the mutual consequential-damages exclusion and the existing treatment of specified incident-response costs as direct damages, and it retains the payment-obligation clarification. The changes are confined to the deficient cap language and are professionally drafted, although “total aggregate liability” is mildly redundant.
